metadata.title: World Digest — November 18, 2026
metadata.summary: Senate summons Nvidia's Huang and Lutnick as Democrats probe the Cantor affair, while Peltola's Alaska win hands the party its largest Senate majority in nearly 70 years.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Democrats Launch Sweeping Investigations into Trump Administration

House Democrats sent preservation notices to over a dozen Trump allies and officials, signaling the start of broad probes The New York Times. The move formalizes plans for wide-ranging investigations.

Peltola Flips Alaska Senate Seat, Democrats Gain Historic Majority

Mary Peltola defeated incumbent Dan Sullivan, giving Democrats 56 Senate seats—their largest majority in nearly 70 years NPR. The win caps a wave of nine flips.

Nvidia Scandal Escalates as Senate Summons Huang and Lutnick

The Senate panel will question Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick publicly, as Democrats probe whether Lutnick helped Cantor Fitzgerald avoid Nvidia-related losses Yahoo Finance. The controversy has divided the Trump administration.

Pew Projects Islam to Overtake Christianity by 2035

New research projects Muslims will outnumber Christians globally by 2035, driven by demographic trends Axios. The shift marks a major religious milestone.

U.S. Loses Measles Elimination Status Amid Outbreaks

Experts expressed dismay as the U.S. lost its measles elimination status, with infants left vulnerable and doctors alarmed The Guardian Axios. The reversal draws criticism of the administration's response.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Tech Outages Spark Bipartisan Pressure, White House Turmoil

JD Vance canceled public appearances amid nationwide tech outages, while the Pentagon and allies prepare for worst-case scenarios Fortune. Karoline Leavitt publicly urged the White House to address the disruptions, which have triggered bipartisan scrutiny of officials Mullin and Clayton The Hill The Independent. A bipartisan Senate letter demands immediate action on AI-enabled cyber threats Politico. Amid the chaos, the White House withdrew Heidi Overton's FDA nomination NPR.

Defense and Foreign Policy Shifts

House Armed Services Chair declared a $350 billion defense reconciliation bill "not going to happen" Breaking Defense. Trump touted a "landmark" trade deal with the Philippines The Hill. Israel's attorney-general froze a key West Bank settlement project Financial Times, while the EU proposed a €45 billion Ukraine loan Reuters.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets

  • Nvidia shares rose despite leadership turmoil; interim CEO Colette Kress said “we’ve got this” CNBC, while quarterly earnings beat and Anthropic anticipation lifted Nasdaq futures Yahoo Finance.
  • Palo Alto Networks jumped 7% after agreeing to buy Applied Compute for $4.5 billion WSJ.
  • Target surged 7% on best sales growth in five years Fox Business.
  • Gold fell to a 14-month low as Fed minutes signaled more rate hikes Investor's Business Daily CNBC.

Economy & Tech

  • A record low in pending home sales points to a bleak housing winter CNBC.
  • Major bank outages disrupted services; JPMorgan resumed after a “software bug” Yahoo Finance.
  • Federal officials denied cyberattacks amid widespread outages Forbes.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI Launches to Near-Universal Acclaim

Reviews call GTA VI a masterpiece, with preorders topping $1.65 billion, potentially the biggest entertainment launch ever CNN. Technical analyses show PS5 Pro runs it best; Xbox Series S struggles, using FSR 4 upscaling from 720p The Verge. PlayStation suffered a widespread network outage hours before release The Guardian. Players can't replay missions but can use multiple save files Eurogamer.net.

Nvidia RTX Spark Mini PCs Ship

Asus, Dell, and MSI launched the first RTX Spark compact desktops. One test showed AI image generation speedups of nearly 22%, though a design flaw was noted The Verge.

Microsoft Agent Framework Compromised

Hijacked releases of Microsoft's official Python agent framework on PyPI stole Azure and CI credentials SecurityWeek.

WhatsApp Backup Backup

WhatsApp's first-party chat history backup service rolled out to beta users on iPhone, offering an alternative to iCloud 9to5Mac.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: Warner Bros. TV and Paramount Television Studios will merge into a single mega-studio under Skydance, with presidents Channing Dungey and Matt Thunell. Los Angeles Times Robert Pattinson is officially cast as James Bond, following Josh O’Connor’s reported exit from the race. The Guardian Dancing with the Stars will air its first-ever live coast-to-coast finale. Deseret News Meanwhile, Anne Hathaway welcomed her third child. The Cut

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Basketball

  • Lakers 118, Hornets 114 – Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 and forced OT on his 10th three with 1.7 seconds left, lifting LA to its ninth straight win ESPN ESPN.
  • Pistons 105, Spurs 93 – Cade Cunningham led a surge as Detroit snapped San Antonio’s 12-game winning streak ESPN.
  • Knicks 111, Raptors 102 – Jalen Brunson’s tiebreaking four-point play and 31 points extended New York’s dominance over Toronto ESPN.

Hockey

  • Oilers 5, Panthers 2 – Connor McDavid’s season-opening points streak reached 23 games ESPN.
  • Wild 7, Predators 3 – Matt Boldy scored twice as Minnesota padded the NHL’s best record ESPN.
  • Blackhawks 6, Maple Leafs 3 – Chicago handed Toronto a seventh straight loss, but lost captain Connor Bedard to a shoulder injury ESPN ESPN.

Football

  • Ravens’ Zay Flowers is “super frustrated” after another late fumble in Monday’s loss ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Several IPOs priced last week on Nasdaq and NYSE, including Modern Mining Technology ($4.25) and vVARDIS Holding ($18) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Upcoming listings include GM and Torex Resources on Nov 17, and Guerrilla RF and Zoar Limited on Nov 18 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Anthropic’s IPO is slated for Nov 19 Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

The S&P 500 dipped 0.23% to 7,323.63, while the Dow fell 1.11% Yahoo Finance. The Nasdaq gained 0.42%, and the Russell 2000 rose 0.46% Yahoo Finance. The VIX dropped 3.53% to 24.56 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Consumer Discretionary led, up 1.79% Yahoo Finance. Technology edged higher (+0.34%), but Energy slumped 3.27% and Health Care fell 2.20% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Amazon jumped 3.82% and Broadcom rose 3.64%, while Nvidia dropped 2.89% Yahoo Finance. Berkshire Hathaway fell 2.07% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Polibeli Group surged 16.8% Yahoo Finance. Ardent Health plunged 18.9% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia was the most active name Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

The 10-year yield fell 0.73% to 5.07 Yahoo Finance. WTI crude tumbled 4.30% to $82.31; gold slid 2.99% Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin was flat at $64,893.95 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24-48 Hours

  • Anthropic IPO (Nov 19): Markets will gauge AI appetite after Nvidia’s earnings beat; volatility likely regardless of pricing.
  • Senate hearing: Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick testify—watch for fresh Nvidia fallout and administration fractures.
  • Tech outages: Bipartisan pressure may force White House action; further disruptions could roil markets.

Next Week

  • Democratic investigations formally launch; subpoena battles may dominate headlines.
  • GTA VI sales records could solidify; watch supply-chain impacts.

Next Month

  • Fed rate-hike signals, housing freeze, and gold’s slide suggest tightening pressure; measles response faces scrutiny.
